passed: Default-off enrollment is private; anonymous, self-enrollment and target-account arguments are denied
Admitted account sees only its aggregate counts, with overlapping upload owners counted once and deletion always disabled
Other users, mismatched sessions and malformed or expired claims reveal no counts
Unconfirmed, banned, deleted, expired-session, expired-enrollment and managed identities are excluded
Administrator warning includes delegated team admins and organization admins, excluding inactive/banned alternatives
Functions are argument-free, stable and fixed-search-path; no data is removed and missing backend data fails visibly
Scope preview inherits live-session enrollment, rejects supplied target IDs, and reveals only current administrator workspaces
Direct/inherited administration is distinguished; organizations show linked counts without leaking unrelated workspaces or member identities
Managed and unconfirmed alternate administrators cannot silently satisfy a handoff
Role mutation is enrolled caller-only, rejects other workspaces and erasure scopes, requires exact confirmation and keeps receipts private
The server blocks sole-admin removal and excludes inactive, banned, deleted, unconfirmed and managed replacements
Direct role removal preserves coaching participation, unrelated permissions and all identities/content; inherited access is explicit and duplicate requests are idempotent
A retry cannot undo a later regrant; organization removal preserves direct team roles, other accounts, workspaces, media and profiles
Role and receipt commit together; failed receipts roll back changes, expired/wrong sessions fail, and the public function stays invoker-only
Actual permission helpers deny removed administration; multiple roles avoid unique-index collisions, preserve guardian/athlete participation and invalidate old role approvals
An inactive assistant-coach conflict blocks atomically without reactivating an old membership or removing the current head coach
Organization deletion is blocked before it can cascade into teams, shared athletes or personal profiles
Synthetic team removal preserves personal identities, athlete profiles and the same athlete’s other team link; athlete guard independently blocks organization cascade
A personal-only account retains its personal deletion preview without any administrator targets
New scope functions are stable, argument-free and fixed-search-path, with an invoker public wrapper
engine: PGlite with actual preflight migration and minimal catalog-shaped synthetic tables including actual preservation constraints; not full erasure acceptance
